Detailed Description

generic parts of icon-lists.

right now only used when compiling with specific parts from evas2.c, should replace gnome-icon-list in the future, however.

Enumeration Type Documentation

enum _icon_state
 

Enumerator:
IE_ALL  all
IE_DK  none
IE_DFL  default
IE_SEL  selected
IE_HI  hilighted (mouse-over)
IE_CL  clicked (will turn into selected when button released)
IE_KBD  keyboard selection
IE_TRO  scrollbars only: trough
IE_BAR  scrollbars only: bar
IE_ABS  scrollbars only: absolute
IE_KEY  tooltips only: key
IE_VAL  tooltips only: value
IE_ID  tooltips only: group-title
IE_THMB  has thumbnail

destruct an icon-element.

if e->data is set, will call icon_el_data_dst(). since the nature of the data is GUI-specific (Evas_Object or such), icon_el_data_dst() is as well. it must be defined in the GUI-specific module.

icon* icon_list_icon_insert (  icon_list *  il,
int  index,
const char *  name,
const char *  file,
const char *  label,
const char *  thumb,
void *  user1,
void *  user2,
int  redraw
) 
 

insert icon into icon-list.

Parameters:
il - icon-list
index - insert after index'th icon (0 for "make first icon in list")
name - the name of the icon-image ("/foo/bar/binary.png")
file - the file represented by the icon ("/bin/ls")
label - the text-label to go underneath the icon-image ("ls")
thumb - the "thumbnail" for the file, or NULL ("/home/azundris/.thumbnails/large/ffa4b11d64a9d082c4b8d4e795d9b3e8.png")
user1 - user-data. in evidence, the stat-info for the icon.
user2 - user-data. in evidence, the file-info for the icon.
redraw - redraw icon-list after icon is inserted?

void icon_list_resized (  icon_list *  il,
long  w,
long  h
) 
 

adjust size of icon-list.

the GUI-part of the icon-list will likely have a callback for when the window's size changes. that callback should in turn call icon_list_resized to let the internal representation know about the change as well. icon_list_resized() will also re-layout the window's contents.

Parameters:
il - the icon-list
w - the new width of the icon-list
h - the new height of the icon-list

icon_list* icon_list_rst (  icon_list *  il  ) 
 

reset icon-list.

this throws out all icons and resets settings to "factory defaults." in other words, it should be similar to destructing an icon-list and making a new one.

Parameters:
il - the icon-list

int pointer_on_icon_p (  icon_list *  il,
icon *  i,
int  x,
int  y
)  [inline]
 

check whether mouse-pointer is over a given icon.

this means "within the icon's bounding box, within an element's bounding box, on a non-transparent pixel". called from icon_list::icon_list_get_icon_at().

Returns:
TRUE or FALSE.
Parameters:
il - the icon-list
i - the icon
x - mouse-x, window-relative
y - mouse-y, window-relative

int  scrolled
) 
 

update scroll-bar and icon-list.

Parameters:
